subject: t-class
notes: Builder general arrangement (private), IC16018 prototype. The image is private and is not stored in Git. All heights use design waterline y=0; longitudinal z=0 is half LOA. This drawing is not the IC16019 as-built design used by parts of vessels/t-class.json. Printed dimensions are retained exactly; pixel picks are approximate. No hull surface or drawing artwork is reproduced.

calibration.note: Effective raster scale, not file DPI: frames 0 to 18 span 430 px and 18 x 1200 mm real = 288 printed mm at 1:75. Two printed 2400 mm deck rises span 96 px = 64 printed mm vertically. These calibration anchors are not independent accuracy checks.

length_overall.note: Printed LOA excludes appendages; raster endpoints are the hull plan ends.

length_waterline.note: Printed LWL for IC16018; do not replace the IC16019 physics LWL without a separate review.

baseline_height.note: Baseline datum; translated by the printed 1261 mm hull draft to design waterline coordinates.

waterline_height.note: Printed hull draft 1261 mm; waterline becomes y=0.

underwing_height.note: Raster height above design waterline. The small printed underwing dimension is ambiguous at this resolution and is deliberately not transcribed.

main_deck_height.note: Printed baseline-to-main-deck height 3500 mm, minus printed hull draft.

upper_deck_height.note: Printed dimension chain: 3500 + 2400 mm above baseline, minus printed hull draft.

wheelhouse_roof_height.note: Printed dimension chain: 3500 + 2400 + 2400 mm above baseline; agrees with 7039 mm printed above waterline.

prop_tip_height.note: Printed maximum draft 1891 mm minus hull draft 1261 mm gives prop tip 630 mm below baseline.

main_to_upper_deck_height.note: Printed deck rise; vertical calibration anchor.

upper_deck_to_roof_height.note: Printed deck rise; vertical calibration anchor.

frame_spacing.note: Printed typical 1200 mm spacing; frames 0 through 19 use this interval. Frame 19 to 20 is the separate printed 900 mm interval.

last_frame_spacing.note: Printed final 900 mm interval from frame 19 to frame 20.

frame_zero_z.note: Frame 0, upper-deck station grid, relative to hull-plan midpoint x=410 px.

wheelhouse_aft_z.note: Aft wheelhouse enclosure wall on upper-deck plan; approximately frame 12.

wheelhouse_fore_z.note: Forward curved enclosure outline on upper-deck plan; approximately frame 16, not the console front.

wheelhouse_width.note: Enclosure width across parallel upper-deck side walls, excluding door swing.

demihull_width.note: Approximate port demihull breadth at frame 8 from hull-plan outer side to inner hull line. Adjacent underwing line and line weight make this tentative; not a waterline section or sponson width.
